statement: Assign each actual center to a single retained domain. Every center assigned to a listed union lies within its certified bounding box. Its pairwise transverse difference is at most t<D; Euclidean separation at least D therefore implies absolute longitudinal difference at least sqrt(D²-t²), and integer differences are at least q=ceil(sqrt(D²-t²)). Ordering all such longitudinal coordinates shows N<=floor(span/q)+1. Hence sum of all listed domain occupancies obeys the cap, with no assumption that individual capacities equal one. Only valid cuts are required: completeness of this cut list is not needed for a negative conclusion.
